Maya: Hey team — quick copy review for the 'Remove Model' confirmation modal. Drafts attached below. Looking for: clarity on severity, CTA wording, and any accessibility nits. :mag: Sam: Thanks! Can you paste the modal copy here? don't want to open Figma. Maya: Sure — root message: Maya: "Remove model from deployment?\nThis will stop serving requests using this model. Existing logs and metrics will be retained.\n\n[Cancel] [Remove]" Maya: Alternate CTAs I've tried: "Delete", "Deactivate", "Remove permanently", "Stop serving" Jordan: I prefer "Stop serving" for accuracy but it's a bit jargon-y for product users. :thinking: Eli: From a product POV, if this is reversible we should avoid "permanently". If it irreversibly deletes model artifacts then say "Delete permanently" + explain consequences. Maya: It's reversible (you can re-enable the model, but versions may be rolled). So we should avoid 'permanently'. Sam: How about: Primary CTA: "Stop serving" (primary, outline red?), Secondary: "Cancel". But I'm worried 'Stop serving' doesn't convey action severity to non-technical PMs. Jordan: UX nit: use a verb-first CTA for clarity. e.g., "Stop serving model" vs just "Stop serving". Maya: Good call. What about "Stop serving this model" — still short. Eli: Also consider telemetry: use consistent naming across UI so events map: action_label: "stop_serving_model". a11y-bot: Contrast/accessibility checklist: - Primary CTA uses red (#D64545) on white -> contrast ratio 3.5:1 which fails WCAG AA for normal text. Buttons need at least 4.5:1. - If we keep red, add 1px darker (#B33A3A) or add 1px border to increase perceived contrast. - Ensure focus ring visible: outline: 3px solid #005fcc or use system focus visible. - Add aria-describedby to describe consequences, e.g., aria-describedby="confirm-desc-1764005555". Maya: Nice — could we keep red but darken to #B33A3A? Sam/Jordan thoughts? Sam: Darker red works for contrast. Also change label to verb-first: "Stop serving model". Secondary: "Cancel". Jordan: Slight tweak: primary copy "Stop serving this model" (matches header sentence). Secondary 'Cancel' ok. Maya: Final proposed modal copy: Header: "Stop serving this model?" Body: "This model will stop receiving new inference requests. Existing logs and metrics are retained. You can re-enable serving but a new rollout may be required." Primary CTA (danger): "Stop serving this model" (bg #B33A3A, color #ffffff) Secondary CTA: "Cancel" Accessibility: add aria-describedby to body, focus ring per a11y-bot. Eli: +1 to that. Also file a small analytics event rename ticket so our logs use "stop_serving_model" consistently. a11y-bot: Quick code snippet for the button aria and focus: ```
This model will stop receiving new inference requests. Existing logs are retained.
``` Maya: Awesome. I'll update the Figma and push copy to the components doc. I'll also attach a screenshot with new color swatch. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Sam: LGTM Jordan: 👍 Eli: Thanks! Maya: filing followups: design->update figma, eng->analytics renaming, a11y->confirm focus proof. I'll create the tickets after this thread. Maya: (bot) created tasks: DES-2412, ENG-5021, A11Y-77 Maya: marking as done here unless anyone objects. Jordan: No objections. :white_check_mark:
